title: String join with wrong argument types
description: Agent uses str.join() with incorrect argument types — passing a list of mixed types instead of ensuring all elements are strings. This is a frequent API misuse pattern.
prompt: Write a Python function `join_items(items: list, separator: str = ', ') -> str` that joins all items in a list into a single string using the given separator. Items may be of any type (int, float, None, bool, str) and should all be converted to strings first. If items is empty, return an empty string. If items is None, return an empty string.

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent calls separator.join(items) without converting items to str, causing TypeError on non-string elements
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: Dictionary merge with nested dict overwrite
description: Agent uses dict.update() for merging nested dictionaries, which overwrites nested dicts entirely instead of deep-merging them. This is a subtle but common API misuse.
prompt: Write a Python function `deep_merge(base: dict, override: dict) -> dict` that recursively merges override into base. If both base and override have a dict value for the same key, merge them recursively. Otherwise, override's value takes precedence. Neither input dict should be modified. If either input is None, treat it as an empty dict.

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent uses dict.update() which overwrites nested dicts instead of merging them recursively
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: Datetime timezone conversion with naive datetime
description: Agent mixes naive and aware datetimes, causing TypeError or incorrect conversions. This is a notorious Python API pitfall.
prompt: Write a Python function `convert_to_utc(dt_string: str, source_tz: str) -> str` that takes a datetime string in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format and a source timezone name (e.g., 'US/Eastern', 'Asia/Kolkata'), and returns the UTC equivalent in the same string format. If the input string is invalid or empty, return an empty string. If the timezone is invalid, return an empty string. Use only the standard library (datetime, zoneinfo).

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent creates naive datetime and calls .astimezone() without localizing first, causing silent wrong results or TypeError
metadata.author: ashish-vipin
